DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。暮らしの相談で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with everyday-life advice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族にも防災の通知を読んでほしいです。日本語以外で確認できる資料や相談先を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族にも防災通知を理解してほしいので、日本語以外の資料や相談先を探していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want my family to read the disaster-preparedness notices too. I am looking for materials or advice services in languages other than Japanese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want your family to understand disaster-preparedness notices too and are looking for materials or advice in languages other than Japanese. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの通知でしょうか。紙や写真をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which notice is it? Do you have the paper or a photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 寮に貼られたこの紙です。日付が古いので、集合場所も今の案内か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 寮の古い掲示を示し、集合場所が現在も同じか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This sheet posted in the dormitory. The date is old, so I also want to check whether the meeting place is still current.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the old dormitory notice and say you want to check whether the meeting place is still the same. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の案内と、希望する言語の資料を担当へ照会しましょう。家族はどの言語なら読みやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us ask the person in charge about the current instructions and materials in your preferred language. Which language is easiest for your family to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベトナム語なら読めます。私だけ説明を聞くのではなく、家族も見て内容を確かめられる物がほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族はベトナム語を読めるので、自分だけが説明を聞くのではなく家族も内容を確認できる資料を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They can read Vietnamese. Rather than only hearing the explanation myself, I want something my family can read to check the contents too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your family can read Vietnamese and you want materials they can check themselves rather than only having the explanation given to you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 資料の有無や説明方法を確認します。寮の管理者にも現在の掲示を問い合わせられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check whether materials are available and how to explain them. You can also ask the dormitory manager about the current notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 管理者へ新しい掲示を聞きます。家族には、古い紙の場所へ行くと今決めず、最新の指示を確認しようと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理者に最新掲示を尋ね、家族にも古い紙の集合場所へ行くと決めず最新指示を確認しようと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask the manager for the updated notice. I will tell my family not to decide now to go to the place on the old paper, but to check the latest instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the manager for the latest notice and tell your family to check the current instructions rather than commit to the old meeting place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 更新の確認と理解の確認を分けて進めてください。緊急時はその時点の案内に従いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check whether the information is updated separately from checking understanding. In an emergency, follow the instructions current at that time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ベトナム語資料と現在の通知を確認します。家族と内容を読み、わからない集合場所は管理者へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ベトナム語の資料と現在の通知を確かめ、家族と読み、不明な集合場所は管理者に尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the Vietnamese materials and current notice. I will read them with my family and ask the manager about any unclear meeting place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check Vietnamese materials and the current notice, read them with your family, and ask the manager about any unclear meeting place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入院している家族へ着替えを届けたいです。面会と荷物の受渡しが別か、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入院中の家族へ着替えを届けたいので、面会と荷物の受渡しが別の手続きか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to deliver a change of clothes to a family member in the hospital. I would like to check whether visiting and handing over belongings are separate matters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to deliver clothes to a hospitalized family member and ask whether visiting and handing over belongings require separate procedures. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の入院先や、荷物について連絡を受けた担当はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know where they are hospitalized and which staff member contacted you about the belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 担当から着替えの連絡がありました。私は面会もできると思いましたが、それはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 担当者から着替えの連絡はあったが、面会もできるかはまだ聞いていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The staff member contacted me about clothes. I assumed I could visit too, but I have not asked about that yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that staff contacted you about clothes, but you have not yet asked whether visiting is also possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物の受渡し方法と面会の条件を担当へ確認します。持参する物は指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the handover method and visiting conditions with the person in charge. Have the items to bring been specified?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 着替えの種類がメモにあります。食べ物も入れたくなりましたが、頼まれていない物を先に入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 着替えはメモに指定されており、食べ物など頼まれていない物は先に追加しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The types of clothing are listed in my note. I also felt like adding food, but I will not put in unrequested items before asking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the clothing is specified in your note and you will not add unrequested items such as food beforehand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 指定された物を分けて用意してください。追加したい物は担当へ相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please prepare the specified items separately. Ask the person in charge about anything you would like to add.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 着替えだけを一つの袋にし、食べ物の可否は聞きます。病状の質問は、本人が希望した連絡担当へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着替えだけを一袋にして食べ物の可否を尋ね、病状は本人が希望する連絡担当に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put only the clothes in one bag and ask whether food is allowed. For questions about the medical condition, I want to check with the contact person the patient has chosen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will bag only the clothes, ask whether food is allowed, and ask the patient's chosen contact about the medical condition. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お荷物と、ご本人に関する説明の相談先を分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will guide you separately about belongings and whom to consult for explanations concerning the patient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 着替えの受渡しと面会条件を先に聞きます。病状をここで周りに聞こえるように話してもらう必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受渡しと面会条件を先に確認し、周囲に聞こえる場所で病状を説明してもらう必要はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first ask about handing over the clothes and the visiting conditions. There is no need to have the medical condition explained here where others can hear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will first check the handover and visiting conditions and do not need an explanation of the medical condition within others' hearing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へおつなぎします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you with the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道で見た出来事の動画を持っています。わかりやすくするため遅く再生しましたが、元の記録も見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 道で見た出来事の動画について、遅く再生した画面だけでなく元の記録も示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a video of an incident I saw on the road. I played it slowly to make it easier to understand, but I would like to show the original record too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to show the original recording of the road incident as well as the slow-playback screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記録した場所と時刻はわかりますか。元のファイルは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know where and when you recorded it? Do you still have the original file?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この交差点です。元のファイルを0.5倍で再生しているだけで、別の編集ファイルは作っていません。遅く見えるので、実際の速さとして説明しないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交差点を示し、元ファイルを0.5倍再生しているだけで別編集はなく、遅く見える映像で実際の速さを断定しないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At this intersection. I am only playing the original file at half speed; I have not made a separate edited file. It looks slow, so I want to avoid describing that as the actual speed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the intersection and explain that you are only playing the original file at 0.5 speed without a separate edit and will not judge the actual speed from the slowed video. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示の設定が0.5倍になっていますね。元のファイルはそのままで、再生を1倍へ戻しました。撮影を始めたのは、どの場面からですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The display setting is 0.5 speed. I have left the original file unchanged and returned playback to normal speed. At what point did you begin recording?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車が曲がったところからです。その前の信号は写っていないので、信号を見たとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影は車が曲がった場面からで、直前の信号は映っておらず自分で見たとも言えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: When the car turned. The traffic signal just before that is not in the video, so I cannot say I saw the signal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that recording began when the car turned, the preceding signal is not shown, and you cannot say you saw it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写っていない部分を想像で付け足さず、担当へ説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain that to the person in charge without adding imagined details for what is not shown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 音も入っていますが、近くの別の人の声です。運転者が言ったことだと決めつけず、音の元は不明な部分も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 音には近くの人の声もあり、運転者の発言とは断定せず、音の元が不明な部分も説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is sound too, but it includes another nearby person's voice. I will not assume it was the driver speaking, and I will also explain the parts where the sound's source is unclear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the audio includes nearby people's voices, you cannot conclude the driver spoke, and you will explain which sound sources are unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元のファイルで再生表示は1倍に戻っています。直前の信号は映っていない、音の話者は未確認として記録します。設定を変えた表示から車の速度は断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Playback of the original file is back at normal speed. We will record that the preceding traffic signal is not shown and the audio speaker is unconfirmed. We will not determine the car's speed from playback with altered settings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 1倍の表示に戻ったことを確認しました。元ファイルは保存したままです。0.5倍で見せたこと、曲がる所から撮ったこと、信号と音の不明点を分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元ファイルは保存したままで再生表示が1倍へ戻ったと確認し、0.5倍で見せたことと撮影開始位置、信号や音の不明点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed playback is back at normal speed. The original file remains saved. I will explain separately that I showed it at half speed, that recording began at the turn, and what is unclear about the signal and sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the original file remains saved and playback is back at normal speed. Explain the earlier 0.5-speed playback, recording start point, and unclear signal and sound information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。情報のご提供ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for providing the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送準備で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you prepare your shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物の宛先ラベルが雨でにじみました。文字を読めるようにしてから送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 雨でにじんだ宛先ラベルを読みやすくしてから発送したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Rain made the address label on my parcel smudge. I would like to make the writing readable before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about making the rain-smudged address label readable before sending the parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていない荷物ですね。住所の原データは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not accepted this parcel yet, correct? Do you still have the original address information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、メモがあります。にじんだ文字を推測して書き足さず、メモから新しいラベルを作ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所のメモは残っているので、にじんだ文字を推測せず原データから新しいラベルを作ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I have a note. I will make a new label from the note rather than guess the smudged characters and write over them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you still have the address note and will make a new label from the original information without guessing the smudged characters. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 読みやすい宛先にしてお持ちください。箱には別の宛先表示も残っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please bring it with a readable address. Are there any other address labels remaining on the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 再利用した箱なので、前の送り状が側面に残っていました。新しい方だけ目立てばよいとは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再利用の箱に旧送り状が残っており、新しい表示が目立つだけでは十分と考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is a reused box, so the old shipping label was still on the side. I do not think simply making the new label stand out is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that an old shipping label remains on the reused box and you do not think making the new label prominent is sufficient. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回と関係ない表示をどう扱うか確認して準備しましょう。箱自体はぬれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check how to deal with labels unrelated to this shipment before preparing it. Is the box itself wet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ラベルだけがぬれ、箱と中身は乾いています。新しいラベルを貼る前に、表面の状態も見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ぬれたのはラベルだけで箱と中身は乾いており、貼り直す前に表面の状態を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only the label got wet; the box and contents are dry. I will also check the surface condition before attaching the new label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that only the label got wet, the box and contents are dry, and you will check the surface before relabeling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先表示と梱包状態を確認してから受付できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can accept it after checking the address label and packaging condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 原データでラベルを作り、古い宛先表示を残さないようにします。乾いた面に整えて、今回の宛先を確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原データからラベルを作り、旧宛先表示を残さず乾いた面を整え、今回の宛先を照合してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will make the label from the original information and avoid leaving the old address labels. I will prepare a dry surface and have you check the address for this shipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will make a label from the original information, remove old address displays, prepare a dry surface, and have this shipment's address checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備が整いましたらお持ちください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it when it is ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。支払い方法で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with payment methods?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公共料金を口座から払うよう申し込みました。手元の払込票も払う必要があるか、対象の月を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公共料金の口座振替を申し込んだが、手元の払込票も支払う必要があるか対象月を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I applied to have my utility bills paid from my account. I want to check which month is covered and whether I also need to pay the payment slip I have.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you applied for utility direct debit but want to check the applicable month and whether your current payment slip still needs paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申込先から、引落し開始の通知は届きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you received a notice from the provider stating when direct debit starts?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。申込みを出した日に、全部の支払いが切り替わったと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開始通知はまだ届いておらず、申込日から全て切り替わったと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought all payments switched over on the day I submitted the application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not received a start notice and thought everything switched over from the application date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申込日と開始日は別に確認しましょう。請求元の案内と払込票を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the application date separately from the start date. Please show me the billing provider's instructions and the payment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この票は先月分です。新しい支払方法の申込みは今月なので、請求元へこの票の扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 払込票は先月分、申込みは今月なので、請求元にこの票の扱いを尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This slip is for last month. I applied for the new payment method this month, so I would like to ask the billing provider how to handle this slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the payment slip is for last month and your application was this month, so you want to ask the billing provider how to handle it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 請求元に照会したところ、手元の票は先月分で、新しい口座振替の開始対象には入らないという回答でした。開始月の回答はまだ来ていません。票の支払期限と、すでに払った記録があるかも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The billing provider replied that this slip is for last month and is not covered by the new direct debit. We have not yet received an answer about the start month. Let us also check the slip's deadline and whether there is a record of payment already.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 票の期限は今月25日です。まだ払った記録はありません。先月分が切替対象ではないことは分かりましたが、この票で払う案内なのかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 票の期限は今月25日で支払記録はないと答え、先月分は切替対象外という回答を確認し、この票で払うのかも尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The deadline is the 25th of this month. There is no payment record yet. I understand last month is not covered by the switch, but I also want to check whether I should pay using this slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the slip is due on the 25th this month with no payment record, confirm last month is outside the switch, and ask whether to pay using this slip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 請求元から、この先月分は手元の票で一度支払い、口座振替は来月分から開始という回答が来ました。申込日から切り替わったわけではありません。支払った後は控えを残し、開始の案内とは別に保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The provider has replied that you should pay last month once using this slip, and direct debit starts from next month's bill. It did not switch over on the application date. After paying, keep the receipt separately from the start notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先月分は25日までにこの票で一度払い、控えを残します。口座振替は来月分からの案内として分けて保管し、申込日から全部切り替わったとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先月分は25日までに票で一度払い控えを残し、口座振替は来月分からという案内と分けて保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pay last month once with this slip by the 25th and keep the receipt. I will separately keep the notice that direct debit starts from next month's bill and will not assume all payments switched on the application date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay last month once with the slip by the 25th, keep the receipt, and store it separately from the notice that direct debit starts from next month's bill. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 先月分の票、今月の申込日、来月分からの開始を分けて確認できました。支払いの完了はまだですので、支払後の控えでも確認してください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have separately confirmed the slip for last month, this month's application date, and the start from next month's bill. Payment is not yet complete, so please also check the receipt after paying. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。売場で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you in the produce area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この根の付いた野菜を初めて買います。食べる部分と下ごしらえを調べる表示を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めて買う根付き野菜について、食べる部分と下ごしらえを調べられる表示を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first time buying this vegetable with roots attached. I want to see a label that helps me find out which parts to eat and how to prepare it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that this is your first time buying the rooted vegetable and you want to see information on edible parts and preparation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 品名の表示をご覧ください。どのような料理に使いたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please look at the product name. What kind of dish do you want to use it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 炒め物です。見た目で葉だけ食べると決めず、使える部分を品名から調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 炒め物に使うが、葉だけを食べると見た目で判断せず品名に合う使い方を調べたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: A stir-fry. Rather than assume from its appearance that only the leaves are eaten, I want to look up which parts can be used based on the product name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will use it in a stir-fry but will not assume from appearance that only the leaves are edible, and want to find suitable uses from its name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品の説明や調理の案内を確認しましょう。今日は量をどれくらい使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the product information and cooking guidance. How much will you use today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人分です。束を全部使うのか、料理に合う量だけかをレシピで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人分を作るので、束全体か料理に必要な量だけかをレシピで確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Enough for two people. I will check the recipe to see whether to use the whole bunch or only the amount suitable for the dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you are cooking for two and will check the recipe to see whether to use the whole bunch or just the amount needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 品名に合う作り方を参考にしてください。保存方法も表示で確かめられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please refer to preparation methods for this specific vegetable. You can also check storage instructions on the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 土が付いているので、ほかの食品と袋を分けたいです。家へ帰ってから下ごしらえします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 土付きの野菜は他の食品と袋を分け、家に帰ってから下ごしらえしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It has soil on it, so I would like to bag it separately from other foods. I will prepare it after getting home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to bag the soil-covered vegetable separately from other foods and prepare it after getting home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋についてはレジでご相談ください。持ち帰り時も商品をつぶさないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask at checkout about bags. Take care not to crush the product on the way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 品名と説明を読んで、一束で作る量を考えます。土付きの物は別袋にし、家で必要な下ごしらえをします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 品名と説明を確認して必要量を考え、土付きの野菜を別袋で持ち帰り家で下ごしらえすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will read the name and description and consider how much to make from one bunch. I will carry the soil-covered items in a separate bag and do the necessary preparation at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the name and description to decide the quantity, carry the soil-covered vegetable separately, and prepare it at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示でわからない点があればお声がけください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask if there is anything unclear on the label. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園のご利用で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you use the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 風景の絵を描きたいです。小さい椅子と道具を置ける場所を、通路の邪魔にならないよう相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 風景画のために椅子と道具を置きたいので、通行を妨げない場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to paint the scenery. I want to ask where I can set down a small chair and my equipment without obstructing the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to put a chair and equipment for landscape painting without obstructing people passing by. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのような道具を使い、どれくらい滞在する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: What equipment will you use, and how long do you plan to stay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 折り畳み椅子と三脚です。午前中描きますが、途中で店へ休憩に行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 折り畳み椅子と三脚を使って午前中描き、途中で店へ休憩に行く予定だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: A folding chair and tripod. I will paint during the morning, but I would like to go to a shop for a break partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will paint during the morning with a folding chair and tripod and plan to take a break at a shop partway through. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの利用案内では、噴水右の通路から外れた舗装スペースで、小さい椅子と三脚を使えます。休憩で離れる時は、道具を残して場所を確保せず、全てお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: These usage instructions allow a small chair and tripod on the paved space off the path to the right of the fountain. When leaving for a break, take everything with you rather than leave equipment to reserve your spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 席を確保するために三脚を残すのはやめます。休憩する時は全部持ち、戻ってから場所を選び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 場所取りのため三脚を残さず、休憩時は全て持ち、戻ってから場所を選び直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not leave the tripod to reserve a spot. I will take everything when I have a break and choose a place again after returning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not leave the tripod to reserve a spot, will take everything during your break, and will choose a place again on returning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路の幅を狭めない置き方も確認してください。画材で周囲を汚す心配はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check that the arrangement does not narrow the path. Might your art supplies dirty the surroundings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水を使います。汚れた水を花壇へ流さず、片付け方を確かめて自分で持ち帰る準備をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水を使うが汚れた水を花壇に流さず、片付け方法を確認して持ち帰る準備をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I use water. I will not pour dirty water into the flower beds. I will check how to clean up and prepare to take it home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you use water but will not pour dirty water into flower beds, and will check cleanup procedures and prepare to take it home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご案内した舗装スペースで、使った水を回収して持ち帰る準備をしてから始めてください。休憩後に戻った時は、空いている場所を選び直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please begin only after preparing to collect the used water and take it home, in the paved space I showed you. When you return after a break, choose an available spot again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 噴水右の舗装スペースを使い、通路は空けます。休憩に出る時は椅子も三脚も持ち、使った水も持ち帰って、戻ったら場所を選び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 噴水右の舗装スペースで通路を空けて描き、休憩時は椅子と三脚を全て持ち、使用水も持ち帰って戻ったら場所を選び直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the paved space to the right of the fountain and keep the path clear. When leaving for a break, I will take both chair and tripod, take the used water home too, and choose a spot again when I return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will paint on the paved space right of the fountain while keeping the path clear, take all chairs and tripods during breaks and take used water home, then choose a place again on returning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。道具と水の準備をして、周りの方に配慮してお楽しみください。ご確認ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01231-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please prepare your equipment and water arrangements and enjoy painting while being considerate of others. Thank you for checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。移動のご案内で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with travel directions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 伊達で乗る予定ですが、券の駅名の漢字を読めません。正式な名前をゆっくり教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切符の駅名の漢字が読めないので、正式な名前をゆっくり教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to board in Date, but I cannot read the kanji of the station name on my ticket. Could you slowly tell me the official name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to be told the official station name slowly because you cannot read the kanji on the ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 券の駅名を見せてください。予約の画面と同じ文字でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the station name on your ticket. Is it written the same way on your reservation screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、同じ文字です。短く伊達と呼んでいたので、ほかの地域の駅と混ざらないよう正式名を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約と券は同じ表記だが短く伊達と呼んでいたので、別地域の駅と混同しない正式名を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the characters are the same. I had just been calling it Date, so I want the official name to avoid mixing it up with stations in other areas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the reservation and ticket use the same writing, but you have been calling it just Date and want the official name to avoid confusing it with another area's station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の表示は「伊達紋別」ですね。読みは「だてもんべつ」です。これは出発駅の欄でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The ticket says Date-Mombetsu, written 伊達紋別 and read だてもんべつ. Is this the departure-station field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出発の欄です。到着地の読みは知っています。出発名だけメモにかなで書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読みを確認したいのは出発欄で、到着地は読めるため出発駅だけかなでメモしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is the departure field. I know how to read the destination. I only want to note the departure name in kana.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the departure field's pronunciation, can read the destination, and want to note only the departure station in kana. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書けたら、券と見比べて復唱してください。ここで地名だけから利用駅を決めないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you have written it, compare it with the ticket and repeat it. Please do not choose a station based only on the place name here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 券とかなのメモを見比べて、もう一度「だてもんべつ」と読みます。同行者へ送るメモには、短い地名ではなく正式名を入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 券とかなのメモを見比べて読み、同行者には短い地名ではなく正式名を送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will compare the ticket with my kana note and read Date-Mombetsu once more. In the note I send my companion, I will use the official name rather than the shortened place name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare the ticket and kana note and read it aloud, then send the official name rather than the shortened place name to your companion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同行者も同じ予約なら、本人の券と照合してもらえますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your companion has the same reservation, they can check it against their own ticket too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出発名のかなと券の画面を一緒に送ります。本人にも確認してもらい、似た駅名を選ばないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式名のかなと券の画面を送り、同行者にも本人の券と照合してもらって似た駅名の誤選択を防ぐと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will send the departure name in kana together with the ticket screen. I will have my companion check too so they do not choose a similar station name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will send the official name in kana and the ticket screen, have your companion compare it with their own ticket, and avoid choosing a similar station name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。券に記載された駅名を確認して、よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please confirm the station name printed on the ticket and have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご家族の相談で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with advice for your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの学校について相談したいです。入学のことと、食事で確認したいことを、どこへ伝えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供の入学と食事について確認したいので、それぞれの相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to ask about my child's school. Where should I raise questions about enrollment and food?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the respective contacts for questions about your child's school enrollment and food. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お子さんはこれから通う予定ですか。すでに学校へ相談しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will your child be starting school? Have you already consulted a school?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これからです。まだ学校が決まっていないので、先に相談先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: これから通う予定で学校は未決定のため、先に相談先を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: They will be starting. We have not chosen a school yet, so I want to find out whom to consult first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your child will be starting school, the school is undecided, and you want to know whom to consult first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入学についての担当を確認します。食事の質問は、どのような内容ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check who handles enrollment. What questions do you have about food?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家庭で食べない食材があります。学校の献立を見たいのですが、私の希望だけで対応できると決めず相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家庭で食べない食材があるので献立を見て相談し、自分の希望だけで対応されるとは決めつけないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are ingredients we do not eat at home. I want to see the school menu and discuss this without assuming my wishes alone guarantee accommodation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that there are ingredients your family does not eat, so you want to see the menu and consult the school without assuming your request alone guarantees accommodation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 希望する内容を具体的に書いて、担当や学校と確認しましょう。言葉の説明でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write your wishes specifically and check with the person in charge or school. Do you need help explaining any terms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 食材の日本語名がわかりません。写真と母語の名前を用意し、同じ意味か確認してから説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 食材の日本語名が不明なので写真と母語名を用意し、同じ意味か確かめてから説明したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not know the ingredient names in Japanese. I want to prepare photos and names in my native language, check that they mean the same thing, and then explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know the Japanese ingredient names and want to prepare photos and native-language names, confirm the meanings match, then explain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その資料で内容を確認できます。必要な対応は担当と相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can check the details using those materials. Please discuss the necessary arrangements with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入学の相談先を聞き、食材は写真と名前で伝えます。入学申込みと食事の相談を一つの返事で済んだとは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入学の窓口と食材の資料を準備し、入学申込みと食事の相談は別々に回答を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask whom to contact about enrollment and describe the ingredients using photos and names. I will not assume one response settles both enrollment and the food discussion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare the enrollment contact and ingredient materials and check the answers to enrollment and food questions separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車椅子の家族に付き添っています。移動は手伝いますが、質問は本人へしてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車椅子の家族に付き添い移動は助けるが、質問は本人にしてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am accompanying a family member who uses a wheelchair. I help with moving around, but I would like you to address questions to them directly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you accompany a family member using a wheelchair and help with mobility but want questions directed to them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人が説明を聞いて答えることを希望されているのですね。話す時の位置に希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: They would like to hear the explanation and answer for themselves, correct? Do they have a preferred position for speaking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人の顔が見える位置で話してほしいです。私の方だけを見て話されると、本人が返事をしにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人の顔が見える位置で話し、付き添いだけを見て説明しないでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like you to speak from where you can see their face. If you look only at me while speaking, it is hard for them to answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask staff to speak from where they can see the person's face and not explain while looking only at the accompanying person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えます。移動の際に、付き添いとして手伝うことも確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the person in charge. We can also check what assistance you will provide when moving around.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 段差や曲がる所は先に声をかけます。押してよいかも本人に聞き、急に動かしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 段差や曲がり角の前に声をかけ、本人に押してよいか聞いてから動かすと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell them before steps or turns. I will also ask whether I may push the wheelchair and will not move it suddenly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will speak before steps and corners and ask permission to push before moving the wheelchair. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の希望を確かめながら移動しましょう。受付の書類はどなたが記入しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us move while checking their wishes. Who will fill out the reception documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人が内容を答え、私が書く部分を手伝います。書いた後は本人にも読んで確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人が内容を答え、自分は記入を手伝い、書いた後は本人に読んで確認してもらうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: They will provide the answers, and I will help with the writing. After writing, I will also have them read and check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the person will provide the answers, you will help write, and they will read and check afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その方法を担当へ伝えてください。ご本人への確認を一緒に進められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person in charge about that approach. We can proceed together with checking with the person themselves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明と返事は本人を中心にお願いします。私は移動と記入を頼まれた範囲で手伝い、内容は本人に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明と返事は本人を中心にし、移動と記入は頼まれた範囲だけ手伝って内容を本人に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please center the explanations and answers on them. I will help with moving and writing only to the extent requested, and confirm the content with them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that explanations and answers should center on the person themselves, while you help with mobility and writing only as requested and check the contents with them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の希望を担当へお伝えします。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01233-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will convey their wishes to the person in charge. Take care.
